title: Mention how Manpages are built in AGENTS.md
body:
The `.md.in` thing is apparently sufficiently obtuse that it isn't always being noticed by LLMs. Add a note that should tell agents that they should prefer edits to `.md.in` when present, and `.md` otherwise.
